Klasse SystemHandler

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.server.handlers.SystemHandler
public class SystemHandler extends Object
Handles all system-level protocol messages on the server side (connect, disconnect, chat, lobbies, movement).

    • handleGameEnd

      public void handleGameEnd(int lobbyId, Map<Integer,Integer> strokeResults)
      Called by the game simulation when all players in a lobby have finished. Computes the winner, prints it to terminal, saves to results.csv, broadcasts SYS_GAME_END, then removes all players from the lobby and deletes the lobby.
